source: Ah, you’re awake, Yoshinori.
translation: 啊，你醒了，Yoshinori。

source: Mnn… Good morning, Sir Goro.
translation: 嗯……早上好，Goro先生。

source: Good morning. I’m just having my coffee.
translation: 早上好。我正在喝咖啡。

source: I’m sorry I couldn’t stay up while we were drinking last night, sir…
translation: 对不起，先生，昨晚喝酒时我没能一直保持清醒……

source: Haha, it’s alright, getting you tipsy worked like a charm. You slept like a baby.
translation: 哈哈，没关系，把你灌得微醺效果很好。你睡得像个婴儿一样。

source: A-Ahh… That’s so embarrassing…
translation: 啊、啊……太丢人了……

source: We had such a long day yesterday though, so I’m not surprised you were that tired.
translation: 不过我们昨天确实度过了漫长的一天，所以你那么累也不奇怪。

source: I’m just glad we enjoyed our time together.
translation: 我只是很高兴我们一起度过了愉快的时光。

source: Me too, sir.
translation: 我也是，先生。

source: You know, it’s been quite some time since I was able to do something like this with someone special.
translation: 你知道吗，我已经很久没有和特别的人一起做这种事了。

source: Really? I thought you and Yuri went on trips like this together.
translation: 真的吗？我以为你和Yuri经常一起这样旅行。

source: Hahaha, I don’t mean it that way, Yoshinori! Yuri’s my daughter.
translation: 哈哈哈，我不是那个意思，Yoshinori！Yuri是我的女儿。

source: What I meant is going out with a partner.
translation: 我的意思是和伴侣一起出门。

source: I used to take my dates on road trips, driving them to all sorts of new places. But that was long ago.
translation: 以前我会带约会对象自驾旅行，开车带他们去各种新地方。不过那已经是很久以前的事了。

source: O-Oh, you mean way back when you were in the uh… biker gang?
translation: 哦、哦，你是说你还在那个……机车帮里的时候？

source: Heh, I bet it’s still hard for you to believe how someone like me could be in a group like that.
translation: 呵，我敢说你现在还是很难相信，像我这样的人竟然会加入那种团体。

source: Heh, I bet it’s still hard for you to believe how someone like me could be in a group like that.{fast}
translation: 呵，我敢说你现在还是很难相信，像我这样的人竟然会加入那种团体。{fast}

source: It seemed out of character.
translation: 感觉和你的性格完全不符。

source: It really seems out of character, especially with the way you’ve always presented yourself to us, sir.
translation: 确实和你的性格完全不符，尤其是你一直以来在我们面前表现出的样子，先生。

source: But then… That just makes me even more curious about what kind of person you were before I met you at Camp Buddy.
translation: 不过这样一来……我就更好奇，在我于 Camp Buddy 遇见你之前，你究竟是怎样的人了。

source: You were my role model.
translation: 你曾是我的榜样。

source: You were my role model, sir. So it’s something I would’ve never expected.
translation: 你曾是我的榜样，先生。所以我怎么都没想到你会有这样的过去。

source: It's not something to be ashamed of.
translation: 这没什么好羞耻的。

source: I really don’t think it’s something to be ashamed of…
translation: 我真的不觉得这有什么好羞耻的……

source: Instead, I can’t help but wonder what kind of person you were before I met you at Camp Buddy, sir.
translation: 相反，我忍不住想知道，在我于 Camp Buddy 遇见你之前，你究竟是怎样的人，先生。

source: It just makes me wonder.
translation: 这只是让我更加好奇。

source: It is hard to imagine, but that just makes me wonder what it was like even more!
translation: 确实很难想象，但这反而让我更想知道那时到底是什么样子！

source: I can’t help but be curious about what kind of person you were before I met you at Camp Buddy, sir.
translation: 我忍不住好奇，在我于 Camp Buddy 遇见你之前，你究竟是怎样的人，先生。

source: Hmmm… I guess I don’t mind telling you, if you really want to know…
translation: 嗯……如果你真的想知道，我倒是不介意告诉你……

source: I-I do, sir!
translation: 我、我想知道，先生！

source: Well… alright. But listen up, ’cause I’m only telling you once.
translation: 好吧……行。但听好了，我只告诉你这一次。

source: In my younger days, I was really into motorcycles and riding was my biggest hobby.
translation: 年轻的时候，我非常喜欢摩托车，骑车是我最大的爱好。

source: I’d always been outgoing and free-spirited at heart, so it only made sense to me at the time to gather people who had the same interests as me. So, I organized a biker’s club.
translation: 我本来就是个外向又崇尚自由的人，所以那时我觉得，召集一群和我兴趣相投的人很合理。于是，我组织了一个机车俱乐部。

source: It’s a common misconception that groups like us were violent, good-for-nothing delinquents.
translation: 很多人误以为像我们这样的团体都是暴力、游手好闲的混混。

source: When in reality, at least in my case, it was all about the brotherhood.
translation: 但实际上，至少对我来说，那一切都是为了兄弟情谊。

source: While I can’t deny that we had our rivals and got into trouble with them often, we never went out of our way to cause harm or commit crimes.
translation: 我不能否认我们有自己的对手，也经常和他们惹上麻烦，但我们从未故意去伤害别人或犯罪。

source: If there was any silver lining, it was during that time that I learned most of the concepts and principles I carry today.
translation: 如果说那段经历有什么积极的一面，那就是我在那时学会了如今一直坚持的大多数理念和原则。

source: As a leader, I learned to handle people from all walks of life, resolve complex conflicts, and live in a culture where mutual respect was paramount.
translation: 作为领导者，我学会了和各行各业的人打交道，解决复杂的冲突，并生活在一个把相互尊重放在首位的文化中。

source: I can imagine it a lot better now…
translation: 我现在能想象得更清楚了……

source: But it wasn’t always that serious either. Being teenagers, we had countless parties and all sorts of crazy ideas to entertain ourselves.
translation: 不过那时也不总是那么严肃。作为十几岁的年轻人，我们举办过无数派对，也想出过各种疯狂点子来寻开心。

source: It was the wildest time of my life, where I lived in the moment and nothing else mattered as long as I was having fun.
translation: 那是我一生中最狂野的时光，我只活在当下，只要开心，其他什么都不重要。

source: I can’t believe I never knew anything even after all these years. These are some really crazy revelations, sir.
translation: 真不敢相信，过了这么多年我竟然什么都不知道。这些真是非常惊人的揭露，先生。

source: I know, right? Honestly, I can’t think of any way that we contributed to society back then.
translation: 我懂，对吧？老实说，我想不出我们那时为社会做过什么贡献。

source: Which is exactly why I’m not proud of it…
translation: 所以我才不以那段经历为荣……

source: No, sir… What I meant was, it’s more unbelievable to me how different you’ve become since then.
translation: 不，先生……我的意思是，你从那以后变化如此之大，这对我来说更难以置信。

source: The explanation for that is rather simple.
translation: 这其实很好解释。

source: It was in my riding days that I met Vera and we had our child.
translation: 我在骑车的那段日子里遇见了Vera，后来我们有了孩子。

source: Having a family, I had to let go of my reckless ways in order to be a good husband, and especially a good father.  The rest is history.
translation: 有了家庭后，我必须放下鲁莽的生活方式，成为一个好丈夫，尤其是一个好父亲。剩下的就都是过去了。

source: Having a family, I had to let go of my reckless ways in order to be a good husband, and especially a good father.  The rest is history.{fast}
translation: 有了家庭后，我必须放下鲁莽的生活方式，成为一个好丈夫，尤其是一个好父亲。剩下的就都是过去了。{fast}

source: Do you miss those times?
translation: 你会怀念那段时光吗？

source: Do you miss the times when you were in your biker group?
translation: 你会怀念在机车团体里的那段时光吗？

source: I do, but I can’t imagine how badly my life would’ve turned out if I hadn’t grown out of it.
translation: 会，但我无法想象，如果我没有走出那段生活，我的人生会变得多么糟糕。

source: It was the right thing to do.
translation: 那是正确的选择。

source: It was the right thing to do, sir.
translation: 那是正确的选择，先生。

source: Yes, I can’t imagine how my life would be now if I had chosen differently.
translation: 是啊，我无法想象，如果当初选择不同的道路，现在的人生会是什么样。

source: It was worth it.
translation: 一切都值得。

source: I think everything you did was worth it, sir.
translation: 我觉得你所做的一切都值得，先生。

source: If it weren’t for you choosing that life, Camp Buddy might never have been formed, and we wouldn’t have even met!
translation: 如果不是你选择了那样的生活，Camp Buddy 也许根本不会成立，我们甚至不会相遇！

source: Yes, I can’t imagine how my life would be now if I stayed the way I was.
translation: 是啊，我无法想象，如果我一直保持原来的样子，现在的人生会是什么样。

source: You've come a long way.
translation: 你已经走了很长的路。

source: You’ve come such a long way, sir.
translation: 你已经走了很长的路，先生。

source: I just hope that you finding out about all of this won’t change the way you see me.
translation: 我只是希望你知道这一切后，不会改变你看待我的方式。

source: No way, sir! If anything, I think it’s really cool! In fact, I wish I could’ve seen it!
translation: 怎么会，先生！要说有什么变化，我反而觉得这很酷！事实上，我真希望自己当时能亲眼见到！

source: Heh… If you did, you’d probably be twice as intimidated by me.
translation: 呵……如果你真的见到了，恐怕会被我吓得更厉害。

source: I-I’m not scared of you, sir...! I just really respect you!
translation: 我、我才不怕你，先生……！我只是非常尊敬你！

source: You’re really insistent on keeping up that formal shtick around me, huh?
translation: 你还真坚持要在我面前保持那套正式腔调啊？

source: Then get your lazy ass up from that bed, scout. We’re on vacation and we’ve already spent half our day cooped up in this room.
translation: 那就从床上起来，别这么懒，童子军。我们在度假，而且已经有一半时间困在这个房间里了。

source: G-Gah…! I’m sorry again for oversleeping!
translation: 嘎、嘎……！我再次为睡过头道歉！

source: Go get dressed in five minutes and let’s have fun out there. Understood?
translation: 五分钟内穿好衣服，我们出去玩。明白了吗？

source: So, Yoshinori. Where to today?
translation: 那么，Yoshinori。今天去哪儿？

source: There’s not much to see there, but I guess it’ll help kill some time.
translation: 那里没什么可看的，不过应该能帮我们消磨时间。

source: How about we check out the lobby again, sir?
translation: 我们再去大厅看看怎么样，先生？

source: You know there’s nothing to see there, Yoshinori.
translation: 你知道那里没什么可看的，Yoshinori。

source: Ah, it seems Yuri’s here as well.
translation: 啊，Yuri似乎也在这里。

source: It looks like she’s on her laptop. Is she working?
translation: 看起来她在用笔记本电脑。她在工作吗？

source: I doubt it. But let’s see.
translation: 我觉得不是。不过我们去看看吧。

source: Yuri-dear, what are you doing here all by yourself?
translation: 亲爱的Yuri，你一个人在这里做什么？

source: Oh my gosh! You guys startled me!
translation: 天哪！你们吓到我了！

source: Let me guess, you’re watching your ‘shows’ on that laptop, aren’t you? Don’t you think that’s something you should be doing in private…?
translation: 让我猜猜，你正在那台笔记本电脑上看你的“节目”，对吧？你不觉得这种事应该私下做吗……？

source: Come on, Dad! I swear I’m not causing trouble!
translation: 拜托，爸爸！我发誓我没有惹麻烦！

source: I already hung out in the café all day yesterday, so I wanted a change of scenery while I’m enjoying my BL~
translation: 我昨天已经在咖啡馆待了一整天，所以享受 BL 的时候想换个环境~

source: I guess this is your idea of a vacation.
translation: 我想这就是你理解的度假吧。

source: Absolutely~! The last few months on the project haven’t really given me any time to consume my BL in peace!
translation: 当然啦~！过去几个月忙项目，我根本没时间安安静静地看 BL！

source: Excuse me, are you Mr. Nomoru?
translation: 打扰一下，您是 Nomoru 先生吗？

source: Ah, yes. Do you need anything?
translation: 啊，是的。有什么事吗？

source: Please forgive me for interrupting your vacation time, but we need to confirm your staff list for the reservation.
translation: 很抱歉打扰您的假期，但我们需要确认您预订时登记的工作人员名单。

source: We thought we’d bring it your attention before we contacted Mr. Clermont.
translation: 我们想在联系Clermont先生之前，先向您确认这件事。

source: Sure, I have everyone’s IDs on file. Would that suffice?
translation: 当然，我保存着所有人的身份证件。这样可以吗？

source: Yes, sir! Kindly follow me this way to verify!
translation: 可以，先生！请跟我来这边核实！

source: I’ll be right back, you two.
translation: 你们两个等我一下，我马上回来。

source: *sigh* Even here Dad’s being chased by work. I really hope he’s had time to enjoy himself this vacation.
translation: *叹气* 都到这里了，爸爸还是被工作追着跑。我真希望他这次度假有时间享受一下。

source: Don’t worry, Yuri! I’ve been tagging along with him since yesterday, and I’m sure he’s having a lot of fun!
translation: 别担心，Yuri！我从昨天起就一直和他一起行动，我敢肯定他玩得很开心！

source: Whew! That’s a relief!
translation: 呼！那我就放心了！

source: I was worried he’d be stressing out about that commitment to Mr. Clermont to make up with Emilia, or other random stuff like that just now.
translation: 我还担心他会因为答应Clermont先生要和Emilia和好，或者刚才类似的其他琐事而烦恼。

source: He tends to take on all those burdens on his own just because he’s our leader.
translation: 他总是因为自己是我们的领袖，就把所有那些负担都一个人扛下来。

source: Yeah… I’m sure it’s difficult to be in Sir Goro’s place.
translation: 是啊……我想站在Goro先生的位置上一定很不容易。

source: He’s always been like that, though. Not just as the camp president, but also as my dad.
translation: 不过他一直都是这样。不只是作为营地负责人，也是作为我的爸爸。

source: I guess I have always wondered… What’s it like having Sir Goro as your father?
translation: 我一直都很好奇……Goro先生作为你的父亲，是什么样的？

source: I know from what I’ve seen, he’s protective of you, but at the same time lets you do the things you enjoy.
translation: 从我看到的情况来说，他很保护你，但同时也会让你做自己喜欢的事。

source: Yeah, pretty much! He always encouraged me to pursue my own interests no matter what they were!
translation: 嗯，差不多就是这样！无论是什么兴趣，他总是鼓励我去追求！

source: Honestly, that’s why I’ve always been closer to him than my mom.
translation: 老实说，这就是我一直比起妈妈更亲近他的原因。

source: Growing up, I never really got along with her…
translation: 我从小就和她不太合得来……

source: It always upset me to see Dad trying so hard to work things out with her, even though it was pointless. Mom was never on the same page as him.
translation: 看到爸爸明明徒劳无功，却还是努力想和她解决问题，总是让我很难受。妈妈从来都和他想不到一起去。

source: She was always away, leaving Dad and I, like we weren’t a family.
translation: 她总是不在家，把爸爸和我丢在一边，就好像我们不是一家人。

source: I-I did get that idea from the few times I met her back when we were scouts.
translation: 我、我在还是童子军时见过她几次，那时确实有这种感觉。

source: You were always bothered when we talked about your family...
translation: 每当我们谈到你的家人时，你总是很难受……

source: It was way worse before Camp Buddy too...
translation: 在 Camp Buddy 之前，情况还要糟得多……

source: I didn’t know any better back then, so I often lashed out whenever I saw them argue.
translation: 那时我什么都不懂，所以每次看到他们争吵，我经常会发脾气。

source: Knowing that Dad had to work twice as hard to raise me really made me resent my mom for constantly fighting with Dad.
translation: 想到爸爸必须付出双倍努力才能养大我，我真的很怨恨妈妈总是和爸爸争吵。

source: It made me feel even more distant from her instead of wanting to build a relationship.
translation: 这让我和她更加疏远，而不是想和她建立关系。

source: But on the other hand, Dad always made time for me no matter how busy he was with work!
translation: 但另一方面，无论工作多忙，爸爸总是会抽时间陪我！

source: I knew how much Dad wanted to give me a perfect family, so I’ve always had a soft spot for him.
translation: 我知道爸爸有多想给我一个完美的家庭，所以我一直对他格外偏爱。

source: That’s why even when he became so stern and shut-off the last few years, all I could do was try to be by his side.
translation: 所以即使他在过去几年变得严厉又封闭，我能做的也只有努力陪在他身边。

source: Because I’ve seen firsthand how much Dad has gone through.
translation: 因为我亲眼见过爸爸经历了多少事情。

source: Yuri…
translation: Yuri……

source: Hey, I’m back. It’s all fixed now. Did I miss anything?
translation: 嘿，我回来了。都解决了。我错过什么了吗？

source: Nope~! We were just chit-chatting!
translation: 没有~！我们只是随便聊聊天！

source: Now, shoo, I wanna focus on my BL and you boys should go out there and do something interesting!
translation: 好了，快走吧，我要专心看我的 BL，你们两个去外面做点有趣的事！

source: Heh. That’s what was I telling Yoshinori here.
translation: 呵。我刚才正是这么和Yoshinori说的。

source: Alright, Yuri! See you later!
translation: 好的，Yuri！回头见！

source: Have fun~
translation: 玩得开心~

source: {i}Hearing about Sir Goro’s past with his family gave me a new sense of respect for he and Yuri’s relationship…{/i}
translation: {i}听到Goro先生与家人过去的经历后，我对他和Yuri之间的关系有了新的敬意……{/i}

source: {i}After we left the lobby, we decided to check out somewhere else in the hotel.{/i}
translation: {i}离开大厅后，我们决定去酒店的其他地方看看。{/i}

source: {i}After we left the lobby, we decided to head back to our room for the night.{/i}
translation: {i}离开大厅后，我们决定回房间休息。{/i}

source: Heh, I was hoping you’d pick that. Let’s go.
translation: 呵，我就希望你选那里。走吧。

source: Want to go check out the club again, sir?
translation: 先生，要不要再去俱乐部看看？

source: I wouldn’t say no to trying out some more drinks.
translation: 再试几种饮料我也不会拒绝。

source: It seems a lot more like a club than a casual pub…
translation: 这里看起来更像俱乐部，而不是普通酒馆……

source: Hey, dude. Wake up. We have guests coming.
translation: 嘿，伙计。醒醒。有客人来了。

source: Ah, the bartender’s right over there. Let me just call him.
translation: 啊，调酒师就在那边。我叫他过来。

source: Hello there, can we have the menu pl—
translation: 你好，可以把菜单给我们——

source: Alright, sir. What’ll we have this time?
translation: 好的，先生。这次想喝点什么？

source: My turn to pick.
translation: 这次轮到我选。

source: Hello there, we’re back. We’d like to make an or—
translation: 你好，我们又来了。我们想点——

source: AIDEN?!
translation: Aiden？！

source: A-Ahehe… Sorry about this! Our friend here had too much to drink last night!
translation: 啊、啊哈哈……真不好意思！我们这位朋友昨晚喝得太多了！

source: He’s with us. We’ll take it from here.
translation: 他和我们一起。接下来交给我们吧。

source: We’ll take it from here.
translation: 接下来交给我们吧。

source: Thanks! Just call me for your orders!
translation: 谢谢！点单时叫我就好！

source: I-Is Aiden alright, sir?
translation: 艾、Aiden没事吧，先生？

source: Yeah, he’s just passed out.
translation: 没事，他只是昏睡过去了。

source: *sigh* Where are his clothes?
translation: *叹气* 他的衣服呢？

source: Boy, wake up.
translation: 小子，醒醒。

source: H-Huh…? Wha—? Where am I…?
translation: 嗯、嗯……？什——？我在哪里……？

source: You’re at the club, Aiden. I think you spent the night here…
translation: 你在俱乐部，Aiden。我想你昨晚是在这里过的……

source: Oh man… I might’ve partied too much…
translation: 天啊……我可能玩得太疯了……

source: This hangover’s intense, my head’s spinning.
translation: 这宿醉太厉害了，我的头一直在转。

source: Here, cover yourself up.
translation: 来，把自己盖好。

source: Mnn… Thanks, Gramps…
translation: 嗯……谢谢，Gramps……

source: What happened to you, Aiden?!
translation: 你怎么回事，Aiden？！

source: Yes. How did you end up in this situation?
translation: 就是。你怎么会变成这样？

source: Well… Last night, I came in to grab a drink, and the bartender convinced me I could join in with the other entertainers!
translation: 嗯……昨晚我进来喝酒，调酒师说服我加入其他表演者！

source: He offered me free drinks, so I thought, sure, why not!
translation: 他给我提供免费饮料，所以我想，当然可以，为什么不呢！

source: Yes. The last we saw you, you were headed to serve a guest…
translation: 是啊。我们最后见到你的时候，你正要去招待一位客人……

source: I spent most of the night hopping from client to client, and man were they thirsty!
translation: 我大半个晚上都在一个客人接一个客人地跑，而且他们真是如饥似渴！

source: So I gave them what they wanted and took my pants off! And then I got a ton of cash!
translation: 所以我满足了他们的要求，还脱了裤子！然后赚了大把现金！

source: A-Aiden… Was that really the best idea?
translation: 艾、Aiden……那真的是最好的主意吗？

source: Oh yeah! I got a bunch of their numbers too, so if you guys ever wanna party with some rich dudes, hit me up~!
translation: 哦，当然！我还拿到了他们一大堆联系方式，所以你们以后要是想和有钱人一起玩，就来找我~！

source: Hehe, maybe we can land a couple more sponsorships for the camp, Gramps~
translation: 嘿嘿，说不定我们还能给营地拉来几个赞助，Gramps~

source: *sigh* I’m not interested in earning money that way, Aiden…
translation: *叹气* 我没兴趣用那种方式赚钱，Aiden……

source: Hmmm… I’m not really sure! Last thing I remember, I was taking a break after finishing up with a client, and the rest is a blur!
translation: 嗯……我也不太清楚！我最后记得的是，招待完一位客人后我在休息，之后的事就模糊了！

source: Haha, I guess I got a little too drunk! The staff didn’t seem to mind though, they got a free view of my bod while I was napping~
translation: 哈哈，我想我大概喝得太醉了！不过工作人员好像不介意，我打瞌睡时他们还能免费欣赏我的身体~

source: You’re lucky nothing else happened, Aiden.
translation: 幸好没有发生其他事情，Aiden。

source: I wouldn't mind if something did happen, hehe~
translation: 要是真发生了什么，我倒也不介意，嘿嘿~

source: Surprisingly, we haven’t gotten any complaints, at least before Emilia.
translation: 令人意外的是，我们还没有收到任何投诉，至少在Emilia那次之前没有。

source: That's the whole point, Gramps! If you got goods to show off, you might as well, right?
translation: 这正是重点，Gramps！既然有好货可以展示，那当然要好好展示，对吧？

source: *ehem* What I’m trying to say is, I just want you to be careful and stay safe with this ‘quirk’ of yours.
translation: *呃咳* 我的意思是，我只是希望你注意安全，谨慎对待你这个“怪癖”。

source: Aww, Gramps~! You're worried about me!
translation: 哎呀，Gramps~！你在担心我！

source: On that note, let’s get you out of here before someone else walks in.
translation: 说到这个，我们还是趁别人进来之前带你离开这里吧。

source: Awww… But I’m still groggy, Grampssss… Can we stay here a little longer?
translation: 啊啊啊……可是我还是迷迷糊糊的，爷爷……我们能不能再待一会儿？

source: W-WAH! You don’t have to carry me, Gramps!
translation: 哇、哇！你不用抱我，Gramps！

source: Wha! Money’s falling out of your underwear! That’s where you put it?!
translation: 什么！钱从你的内裤里掉出来了！你把钱放在那里？！

source: Yoshinori, look for his clothes then follow us to our room.
translation: Yoshinori，找找他的衣服，然后跟我们回房间。

source: Ow, ow, Gramps! You’re crushing my balls…!
translation: 疼、疼，Gramps！你压到我的蛋蛋了……！

source: W-Wait, Aiden’s not dressed yet!
translation: 等、等等，Aiden还没穿衣服呢！

source: I think these are what you’re looking for.
translation: 我想你找的是这些。

source: Ah yes, that’s Aiden’s clothes! Thank you!
translation: 啊，是的，那是Aiden的衣服！谢谢你！

source: So sorry about all that! We’ll be on our way!
translation: 刚才真是不好意思！我们这就走！

source: Hehe, throuples.
translation: 嘿嘿，三人情侣关系。

source: {i}Sir Goro and I brought Aiden back to our room and gave him some medicine to help with his hangover.{/i}
translation: {i}Goro先生和我把Aiden带回房间，给他吃了些药来缓解宿醉。{/i}

source: {i}We left him to rest and headed out to check another area of the hotel.{/i}
translation: {i}我们让他休息，然后出门去看看酒店的另一个区域。{/i}

source: {i}He hung out with us until he felt better, and then left to go shower in his room.{/i}
translation: {i}他和我们一起待到感觉好些，然后回自己的房间洗澡。{/i}

source: How about we take a dip in the bathhouse again, sir?
translation: 先生，我们再去浴场泡一会儿怎么样？

source: Hehe, you read my mind. Let’s go.
translation: 嘿嘿，你猜中了我的想法。走吧。

source: Hehe, you better behave this time around, Yoshinori. The bath’s a lot more crowded than yesterday.
translation: 嘿嘿，这次你最好规矩一点，Yoshinori。今天浴池比昨天拥挤多了。

source: A-As long as you don’t sneakily try to seduce me, sir…
translation: 只、只要你不偷偷勾引我，先生……

source: Oh. Yoshi. Sir Goro.
translation: 哦。Yoshi。Goro先生。

source: Why don’t you guys join us then? There’s plenty of room beside me and Yoshinori here in the tub!
translation: 那你们不如加入我们吧？浴池里我和Yoshinori旁边还有很多位置！

source: Haha! Don’t worry, you’ll get used to it if you stay in longer.
translation: 哈哈！别担心，你多泡一会儿就会习惯的。

source: Did you two have a group ‘workout’ yesterday?
translation: 你们两个昨天做了团体“锻炼”？

source: Yeah, Yoshinori. Get your mind out of the gutter.
translation: 是啊，Yoshinori。别想歪了。

source: Speaking of gutters, Lloyd has a deep one.
translation: 说到“歪”，Lloyd的可深了。

source: DAR!
translation: DAR！

source: {i}Sir Goro and I stayed a little longer to chat with Lloyd and Darius, while we all relaxed in the hot bath.{/i}
translation: {i}Goro先生和我多待了一会儿，和Lloyd、Darius聊天，同时一起在热水浴池里放松。{/i}

source: Sure, I’m curious what the menu is like there.
translation: 好啊，我也很好奇那里的菜单。

source: Sure. We can grab a light snack.
translation: 好。我们可以吃点清淡的小吃。

source: Wow, look at all these fancy-sounding drinks and desserts! They all look delicious, sir!
translation: 哇，看看这些名字听起来很高级的饮料和甜点！看起来都很好吃，先生！

source: Yeah. I’ll get us some and we can chill here for a while. Everything we order is paid for anyway.
translation: 好。我去给我们拿一些，我们可以在这里放松一会儿。反正我们点的东西都已经付过钱了。

source: We should enjoy that while it lasts! Haha!
translation: 我们应该趁现在好好享受！哈哈！

source: Looking at the menu, I might order some exotic black coffee. Maybe you could pick a snack we can share?
translation: 看着菜单，我可能会点一杯异国风味的黑咖啡。你来选一种我们可以分享的小吃？

source: Looking at the menu, I might order some exotic black coffee. Maybe you could pick a snack we can share?{fast}
translation: 看着菜单，我可能会点一杯异国风味的黑咖啡。你来选一种我们可以分享的小吃？{fast}

source: Hotdog sandwich.
translation: 热狗三明治。

source: How about a hotdog sandwich, sir?
translation: 先生，要不要来个热狗三明治？

source: Oh, I’d love it if you sandwiched my hotdog.
translation: 哦，要是你肯亲自把我的“热狗”夹起来，我当然乐意。

source: Bread Roll.
translation: 面包卷。

source: Bread rolls look good.
translation: 面包卷看起来不错。

source: Bread rolls, you say? *lifts shirt up a little*
translation: 你说面包卷？*稍微掀起衬衫*

source: Baguette.
translation: 法棍。

source: How about that whole wheat baguette, sir?
translation: 先生，要不要来一整根全麦法棍？

source: Oh, I’ll show you a whole meat baguette.
translation: 哦，我给你看看一根“全肉法棍”。

source: Cream-Filled Donut.
translation: 奶油夹心甜甜圈。

source: How about some cream-filled donut holes!
translation: 来点奶油夹心甜甜圈洞怎么样！

source: Oh, I’ll cream fill your donut hole.
translation: 哦，我来给你的甜甜圈洞里灌满奶油。

source: S-Sir!
translation: 先、先生！

source: Hahaha! Come on, you asked for that one!
translation: 哈哈哈！别这样，是你自己挑起的！

source: You know what? I could get used to this.
translation: 你知道吗？我好像能习惯这个。

source: I won’t…!
translation: 我才不会……！

source: Anyway, I’ll go place our order. Go and find us a table.
translation: 总之，我去下单。你去找张桌子。

source: *sigh* Okay, sir…
translation: *叹气* 好的，先生……

source: Alright, maybe somewhere in the back…
translation: 好吧，也许去后面找个地方……

source: Sir Goro and I are actually here to grab a meal. I just happened to notice you were having a problem with the staff again.
translation: Goro先生和我其实是来吃饭的。我只是碰巧注意到你又和员工起冲突了。

source: That was hard to watch…
translation: 真让人难以旁观……

source: A-Ah…! I didn’t realize you were there, sir…
translation: 啊、啊……我没意识到你在这里，先生……

source: I just arrived. What happened?
translation: 我刚到。发生什么了？

source: Sadly, she’s always been like that…
translation: 遗憾的是，她一直都是这样……

source: Even when she was a scout, all she ever did was complain and push people away…
translation: 即使她还是童子军时，也只会抱怨，把别人推开……

source: I don’t think that was her intent… She’s had a lot of problems she had to deal with even back then.
translation: 我不觉得那是她的本意……她从那时起就有很多问题要面对。

source: Sadly, what you overheard was true.
translation: 可惜，你无意中听到的都是真的。

source: I only met her parents once when they enrolled her in the camp. And let’s just say they made a… lasting impression.
translation: 我只在她被父母送来营地时见过他们一次。只能说，他们给人留下了……深刻的印象。

source: They talked about their own daughter as if it was a nuisance to deal with her.
translation: 他们谈论自己的女儿时，就好像照顾她是一件麻烦事。

source: As a parent myself, I couldn’t understand that at all.
translation: 作为父亲，我完全无法理解。

source: None of us know the whole story but I can understand a little why she acts like that…
translation: 我们都不知道全部真相，但我能稍微理解她为什么会那样……

source: You were always so nice to her. But then, you’re always nice to everyone.
translation: 你一直对她那么好。不过，你对所有人都很好。

source: Well... We never know what’s going on behind the scenes in people’s lives, so it’s best to give them the benefit of the doubt…
translation: 唉……我们永远不知道别人生活的幕后到底发生了什么，所以最好还是相信他们没有恶意……

source: Still, it’s unfortunate she never grew out of her past attitude.
translation: 不过，她一直没有摆脱过去的态度，实在很遗憾。

source: Anyway, try not to get too bothered by it. Let’s sit down and enjoy our snacks.
translation: 总之，尽量别被这件事影响。我们坐下享用小吃吧。

source: Alright, Sir Goro. Thanks.
translation: 好的，Goro先生。谢谢。

source: {i}Thankfully, Sir Goro was there to get my mind off of her.{/i}
translation: {i}幸好Goro先生在这里，让我不再想着她。{/i}

source: {i}We stayed a little longer, enjoying our snacks with the beautiful view.{/i}
translation: {i}我们多待了一会儿，一边享用小吃，一边欣赏美丽的景色。{/i}

source: {i}We stayed a little longer, relaxing and enjoying the afternoon.{/i}
translation: {i}我们多待了一会儿，放松地享受着下午时光。{/i}

source: Why don’t we go and check on Jin?
translation: 我们为什么不去看看Jin？

source: Yeah. He might need some encouragement getting out of his room.
translation: 是啊。他可能需要有人鼓励他走出房间。

source: I don’t mind. Maybe they’re up to something interesting.
translation: 我不介意。也许他们正在做什么有趣的事。

source: That sounds like something you’d be more interested in.
translation: 听起来更像是你会感兴趣的事。

source: Yes, Jin. You’re supposed to take it slow – if you go too fast, it can be painful.
translation: 对，Jin。你应该慢慢来——太快的话会很痛。

source: Have you been in here since yesterday?
translation: 你从昨天起就一直待在这里吗？

source: Y-Yes, sir. Guilty as charged.
translation: 是、是的，先生。罪证确凿。

source: Today’s the last day of vacation, are you not planning to go explore around the hotel at all?
translation: 今天是度假的最后一天，你不打算在酒店里到处逛逛吗？

source: No, sir…
translation: 不，先生……

source: Well, I hope you don’t mind if we hang out here with you then.
translation: 好吧，希望你不介意我们和你一起待在这里。

source: O-Oh no, sir…! I wouldn’t want you guys to miss out on all the fun stuff around the hotel!
translation: 哦、哦，不，先生……！我不想让你们错过酒店里所有有趣的东西！

source: It’s fine! We needed to rest a little anyways!
translation: 没关系！反正我们也需要休息一会儿！

source: Hehe… Careful with your phrasing, Yoshinori. You’re giving Jin a different idea.
translation: 嘿嘿……注意你的措辞，Yoshinori。你让Jin产生了别的想法。

source: Sorry about Yoshinori here, I don’t think he’s fully gotten his mind off of a certain ‘event’ yesterday.
translation: 抱歉，Yoshinori刚才还没完全从昨天的某个“事件”中回过神来。

source: Sure. I don’t mind telling you another story.
translation: 当然。我不介意再给你讲一个故事。

source: I’m off.  I’ll be back next week.
translation: 我要走了。下周回来。

source: You’re heading out again?
translation: 你又要出门？

source: There’s nothing for me to do here. You can’t expect me to sit around here and watch you play house with a bunch of scouts.
translation: 我在这里没什么可做的。你不能指望我一直待在这里，看着你和一群童子军过家家。

source: But today is…
translation: 但今天……

source: Tch…
What? Why are you giving me that face?
translation: 什么？你为什么要摆出那副表情？

source: I don’t understand why you hate making time for us.
translation: 我不明白你为什么讨厌抽时间陪我们。

source: Am I not here right now? I stayed here all day yesterday, and what did you and Yuri have me do? Nothing!
translation: 我现在不就在这里吗？我昨天在这里待了一整天，可你和Yuri让我做了什么？什么都没有！

source: And you have the nerve to say that I don’t make time?!
translation: 你居然还有脸说我不抽时间陪你？？！

source: And you’re one to talk, ever since you built this stupid camp!
translation: 你也好意思说我？自从你建了这个蠢营地以后就是这样！

source: You quit your job and put all your savings into this without me knowing, and now you expect me to play along and act as if everything is perfect?!
translation: 你辞掉工作，把所有积蓄都投进这里，却不告诉我，现在还指望我配合你，装作一切都完美无缺？！

source: You know I did this for Yuri! I did it for us!
translation: 你知道我这么做是为了Yuri！也是为了我们！

source: Oh, don’t give me that bullshit! Why can’t you admit that the real reason you’re doing this is only for yourself?!
translation: 少跟我扯这些废话！你为什么不能承认，你这么做的真正原因只是为了你自己？！

source: You’re obsessed with reliving your younger days and being the boss.
translation: 你沉迷于重温年轻时的日子，沉迷于当老大。

source: Why can’t I go out and do what I want then?!
translation: 那我为什么不能出去做自己想做的事？！

source: You’ve already taken so much of my youth away from me! You knew I never wanted any of this!
translation: 你已经夺走了我太多青春！你明知道我从来都不想要这一切！

source: I agreed to keep that child, but you know I never wanted to be a mother, and I should never have agreed to be your wife!
translation: 我同意留下那个孩子，但你知道我从来不想当母亲，我也根本不该同意嫁给你！

source: But we did it, Vera! We’re married! We made our vows!
translation: 但我们已经这么做了，Vera！我们结婚了！我们发过誓！

source: Screw that! I did my part!! Our daughter’s old enough, what else do you want from me?!
translation: 去他的！我已经尽到了自己的责任！！我们的女儿已经成年了，你还想从我这里得到什么？！

source: You’ve gotta know at this point that we’re just dragging this out.
translation: 你现在应该知道，我们只是在把这段关系拖下去。

source: Eighteen. YEARS. We’re both sick of it!
translation: 十八。年。我们都受够了！

source: Tsk.
translation: 啧。

source: Vera, wait—!
translation: Vera，等等——！

source: Ah, shit…
translation: 啊，该死……

source: *ehem* Come in!
translation: *呃咳* 进来！

source: Umm… Sir Goro?
translation: 呃……Goro先生？

source: Ah, Yoshinori! What brings you here?
translation: 啊，Yoshinori！你来这里做什么？

source: W-Well… I was waiting by the door until Ms. Vera walked out…
translation: 嗯、嗯……我在门边等着，直到Vera女士走出来……

source: Are you okay…?
translation: 你还好吗……？

source: Ah, I’m sorry you had to hear that. But yes, I’m quite alright.
translation: 啊，很抱歉让你听到那些。不过我很好。

source: I-I know it’s not my place, sir, but… if you need someone to talk to, I’m always here!
translation: 我、我知道这不该由我说，先生，但是……如果你需要找人谈谈，我随时都在！

source: I might have no experience as a camp leader, father, or a husband, but… I’ll try my best to listen and understand!
translation: 我可能没有当营地负责人、父亲或丈夫的经验，但是……我会尽力倾听和理解！

source: H-Hehe… You’re as innocent as ever, Yoshinori, but you always mean well.
translation: 嘿、嘿嘿……你还是一如既往地天真，Yoshinori，但你的心意总是好的。

source: Either way, I appreciate your offer. I won’t forget it.
translation: 不管怎样，我很感谢你的好意。我不会忘记的。

source: We’re your family too, sir!
translation: 我们也是你的家人，先生！

source: Heh… Never imagined I’d be hearing all this from a scout… But you’re right.
translation: 呵……真没想到我会从一个童子军那里听到这些……但你说得对。

source: Wah, really?!
translation: 哇，真的吗？！

source: Yes, really. Who knew we’d get along so well, right?
translation: 是真的。谁能想到我们会相处得这么好，对吧？

source: Anyway, did you need anything from me?
translation: 对了，你找我有什么事吗？

source: Umm… Yes! I need you to come to the mess hall with me, sir!
translation: 呃……有！先生，我需要你和我一起去餐厅！

source: What for?
translation: 去那里做什么？

source: You’ll see!
translation: 你去了就知道！

source: Do I really have to close my eyes?
translation: 我真的必须闭上眼睛吗？

source: You can open them now, sir!
translation: 现在可以睁眼了，先生！

source: HAPPY BIRTHDAY!
translation: 生日快乐！

source: To the bestest dad and scoutmaster ever!
translation: 敬全世界最棒的爸爸和童军团长！

source: You didn’t think I’d forget, did you Dad?! It’s been so hard pretending all morning!
translation: 你不会以为我会忘记吧，爸爸？！整个上午假装什么都不知道可太难了！

source: It was Yoshinori’s idea to throw you a party, though!
translation: 不过，给你办派对是Yoshinori的主意！

source: Oh, but everyone worked hard on the decorations! And of course, Mr. Andre and Aiden cooked all the food!
translation: 哦，但装饰是大家一起努力完成的！当然，Andre先生和Aiden还做了所有食物！

source: We cooked all your favorites, sir.
translation: 我们做了你最喜欢的菜，先生。

source: We weren’t sure how old you were, so we just had each scout stick a candle in there!
translation: 我们不知道你多大，所以就让每个童子军都在蛋糕上插了一根蜡烛！

source: He’s only thirty-eight.
translation: 他才三十八岁。

source: Thank you, everyone.
translation: 谢谢大家。

source: No, thank you, sir! If you didn’t build Camp Buddy, we wouldn’t have the greatest summer ever!
translation: 不，应该谢谢你，先生！如果不是你建立 Camp Buddy，我们就不会拥有最棒的夏天！

source: Awwww~ You made Dad cry, Yoshi!
translation: 哎呀呀~你把爸爸感动哭了，Yoshi！

source: N-No, some confetti just got in my eye…!
translation: 不、不是，有些彩屑进了我的眼睛……！

source: Hurry up, blow the candles off your fire-cake already!
translation: 快点，把你生日蛋糕上的蜡烛吹掉！

source: Aww… It’s so sweet everyone threw you a party, Sir Goro!
translation: 啊……大家为你办派对真是太贴心了，Goro先生！

source: The credit goes to Yoshinori. He was quite the thoughtful scout, you know.
translation: 这要归功于Yoshinori。你知道，他真是个体贴的童子军。

source: Ahehe… It’s really nothing, sir..
translation: 啊哈哈……真的没什么，先生。

source: A-Anyway, I really appreciate you guys’ company, and for helping me out with the blog project…
translation: 不管怎样，我真的很感谢大家的陪伴，也谢谢你们帮我完成博客项目……

source: Are you sure you don’t want to come with us and tour the hotel some?
translation: 你确定不想和我们一起去逛逛酒店吗？

source: No thanks, I think I’ll keep working on this for a little while longer!
translation: 不用了，我想再继续做一会儿这个！

source: Well, if that’s the case, we’ll be on our way, Jin.
translation: 好吧，既然这样，我们就先走了，Jin。

source: As long as you’re enjoying this vacation, then that’s what matters.
translation: 只要你享受这次假期，那才是最重要的。

source: Th-Thank you, sir!
translation: 谢、谢谢你，先生！

source: But one of these days, you’re going to come with us and we’re going to party. And that’s an order!
translation: 但总有一天，你要和我们一起出来玩，我们还要开派对。这是命令！

source: Phew, today was jam-packed again!
translation: 呼，今天又是满满的一天！

source: Haha, true. But we somehow finished touring around even earlier than yesterday, so there’s still a few hours left before bed.
translation: 哈哈，没错。不过我们不知怎么比昨天更早逛完了，现在离睡觉还有几个小时。

source: Yeah, although I’m not sure how much more I’m up for, haha!
translation: 是啊，不过我不确定自己还能撑多久，哈哈！

source: By the way, I know I’ve been pretty clear about how much I’ve enjoyed the trip so far, but how about you?
translation: 对了，虽然我已经很明确地说过自己有多享受这次旅行，但你呢？

source: I’m enjoying it just as much, sir! I never would’ve thought I’d be able to experience all this luxury in my life.
translation: 我也一样享受，先生！我从没想过自己有一天能体验到这样的奢华。

source: Haha, I could say the same. We get to live like millionaires for a few days.
translation: 哈哈，我也一样。我们有几天可以过上百万富翁的生活。

source: Yeah… I had to look up how much it cost to book this place, and honestly it’s nowhere near what I can afford.
translation: 是啊……我还查过预订这里要花多少钱，说实话，完全不是我能负担得起的。

source: I was worried you might not enjoy it here as much because of that, knowing how you prefer simpler things.
translation: 我还担心你会因为这个没那么享受这里，毕竟我知道你更喜欢简单的生活。

source: But I’m glad that didn’t end up being the case.
translation: 但我很高兴最后并没有这样。

source: Well, it was only because I was with you, sir!
translation: 嗯，那只是因为和你在一起，先生！

source: It’s a shame we’re going to be checking out tomorrow.
translation: 明天就要退房了，真可惜。

source: Oh, already?! Time’s moved so fast the past few days…
translation: 什么，已经要走了吗？！这几天时间过得太快了……

source: Well, we can always go out again someday when we finish the project.
translation: 等我们完成项目后，以后总可以再一起出来。

source: Spending this vacation with you gave me some ideas of what we can do in the future.
translation: 和你一起度过这次假期，让我想到了一些未来可以做的事。

source: But I want to know, what is a perfect vacation to you?
translation: 但我想知道，对你来说，什么是完美的假期？

source: But I want to know, what is a perfect vacation to you?{fast}
translation: 但我想知道，对你来说，什么是完美的假期？{fast}

source: Staycation.
translation: 居家度假。

source: I’m fine staying at Camp Buddy, sir! No need to go anywhere fancy!
translation: 我待在 Camp Buddy 就很好，先生！不用去什么豪华的地方！

source: Well, it doesn’t have to be fancy. I’d really like to take you somewhere new!
translation: 嗯，不一定要豪华。我真的很想带你去个新地方！

source: Hotel.
translation: 酒店。

source: Take me back here, sir!
translation: 带我回这里吧，先生！

source: Heh, you really like fancy living, huh?
translation: 呵，你真的很喜欢奢华生活啊？

source: Sure, I’ll bring you back, but don’t you want to try something new?
translation: 好，我会带你回来，不过你不想试试新地方吗？

source: Roadtrip.
translation: 公路旅行。

source: I think it’d be fun to drive around somewhere just exploring!
translation: 我觉得开车到处走走、随便探索一定很有趣！

source: Hehe, you know I’m into that.
translation: 嘿嘿，你知道我就喜欢这个。

source: Yeah, we could even camp out, no need for fancy hotels!
translation: 是啊，我们甚至可以露营，不需要什么豪华酒店！

source: Travel.
translation: 旅行。

source: It’d be really exciting to travel the world with you, sir!
translation: 先生，和你一起环游世界一定会非常令人兴奋！

source: I agree. There’s so much out there to see.
translation: 我同意。外面的世界还有太多值得看的东西。

source: I probably need to save a lot of money for that though.
translation: 不过为了这个，我可能得存很多钱。

source: You don’t need to worry about the money. I’ll handle everything.
translation: 你不用担心钱。一切交给我。

source: Y-You don’t have to do that, sir.
translation: 你、你不用这样，先生。

source: I want to. The moments and memories are priceless.
translation: 我想这样做。那些时刻和回忆是无价的。

source: Oh?
translation: 哦？

source: Hi Dad~!
translation: 嘿，爸爸~！

source: Hehe, hope we’re not interrupting anything spicy~
translation: 嘿嘿，希望我们没有打断什么刺激的事情~

source: Not at all. What brings you two here?
translation: 完全没有。你们两个来这里做什么？

source: Wait… What’s with all the luggage?
translation: 等等……这些行李是怎么回事？

source: Oh, the receptionist told us that we have a scheduled formal dinner tonight down at the restaurant.
translation: 哦，接待员告诉我们，今晚餐厅安排了正式晚宴。

source: Wow, and here I thought this trip couldn’t get any fancier.
translation: 哇，我还以为这次旅行已经不可能更豪华了。

source: You’re telling me! Who knew they’d throw a fancy dinner at us to top off the trip?!
translation: 你说得没错！谁能想到他们会用一场豪华晚宴为旅行画上句号？！

source: W-Wait, did you say formal dinner, Yuri? I don’t think any of us packed appropriate clothing for something like this…
translation: 等、等等，你说正式晚宴，Yuri？我觉得我们谁都没带适合这种场合的衣服……

source: Here, guys. The hotel staff delivered the invitations and something for each of us to wear!
translation: 给你们。酒店工作人员送来了请柬，还有给我们每个人准备的衣服！

source: Now it makes sense why Mr. Clermont was asking for our measurements a few weeks ago…
translation: 现在我明白几周前Clermont先生为什么要问我们的尺寸了……

source: I guess he was collecting them to get these clothes made for us.
translation: 我想他收集尺寸就是为了给我们做这些衣服。

source: Man, talk about being extra… am I right?
translation: 天啊，真够夸张的……对吧？

source: I’ve always wanted to experience a top tier five-star dinner! I wonder if there’s gonna be some entertainment like a gala or a ball!
translation: 我一直想体验一次顶级五星级晚宴！不知道会不会有像晚会或舞会那样的娱乐活动！

source: Couples dancing to the music, sharing a glass of wine, and all the fancy food they can eat!
translation: 情侣们随着音乐跳舞，共享一杯葡萄酒，还有吃不完的精致美食！

source: So romantic~!
translation: 好浪漫~！

source: Yuri… It’s fine dining. I don’t think there’s going to be any dancing involved.
translation: Yuri……这是高级餐厅。我不觉得会有跳舞环节。

source: I’m still excited either way!
translation: 不管怎样我还是很兴奋！

source: This invitation says our reservation is an hour from now.
translation: 请柬上说我们的预订时间是一个小时后。

source: Then we better start dressing up now, or we’ll be late.
translation: 那我们最好现在就开始打扮，不然会迟到。

source: Well, you guys go ahead! Aiden and I have to go bring everyone their suits!
translation: 好了，你们先去吧！我和Aiden得去把大家的西装送过去！

source: Let’s all just meet at the resto!
translation: 我们餐厅见吧！

source: Sure thing.
translation: 没问题。

source: I’ve always wanted to take you out on a dinner like this, Yoshinori.
translation: 我一直想带你参加这样的晚宴，Yoshinori。

source: Ahehe… I haven’t experienced anything like it before, so I’m counting on you to lead the way, sir.
translation: 啊哈哈……我以前从没经历过这样的事，所以今晚就靠你带路了，先生。

source: What a perfect way to end our trip. I’m sure we’ll have an amazing night.
translation: 这真是结束旅行的完美方式。我相信今晚会非常精彩。

source: I should’ve expected this considering the rest of the hotel, but this place is just as extravagant…
translation: 考虑到酒店其他地方的风格，我本该预料到的，但这里同样奢华……

source: Everywhere you look there’s gold and crystals… they’re almost blinding me.
translation: 目之所及都是黄金和水晶……简直快把我的眼睛晃瞎了。

source: Luckily we had our suits provided for us. We blend right in.
translation: 幸好我们的西装是酒店提供的。我们和这里很搭。

source: Yeah… Even if I’d known about this, I doubt anything in my wardrobe would be fitting for tonight!
translation: 是啊……就算我知道会来这里，我衣柜里的衣服恐怕也没有一件适合今晚！

source: Well, you have been wearing suits lately thanks to all those meetings we attended together, but this is different.
translation: 你最近因为我们一起参加的那些会议，也一直穿着西装，不过这次不一样。

source: You look dashing… and really handsome, I should say.
translation: 你看起来真潇洒……我应该说，真的很帅。

source: Ah… Thank you, sir. You look good as well…!
translation: 啊……谢谢你，先生。你看起来也很帅……！

source: A-And you smell very nice too…
translation: 而且你闻起来也很香……

source: Hehe, I figured I’d wear my special cologne for this occasion.
translation: 嘿嘿，我想这次场合该用我特别的古龙水。

source: You’re not the only one paying attention, though. I see you’re wearing that brooch I gave you again.
translation: 不过注意到这些的可不只有你。我看到你又戴上了我送你的胸针。

source: Yes, sir. I thought it would match the style. It’s been a long time since I wore something this nice.
translation: 是的，先生。我想它和风格很相配。我已经很久没戴过这么漂亮的东西了。

source: Business suits are one thing, but the last time I was in full formal wear was my prom.
translation: 商务西装是一回事，但我上一次穿全套正装还是在毕业舞会上。

source: Oh, those days are so far behind me. You’re not making me feel any younger.
translation: 哦，那些日子已经离我很远了。你这样说得我感觉自己一点都不年轻了。

source: But we do look good together, sir! Hahaha!
translation: 不过我们站在一起确实很好看，先生！哈哈哈！

source: Now we’re just buttering each other up.
translation: 现在我们只是在互相吹捧了。

source: Hiii guuuys~!
translation: 嗨——大家~！

source: Oh wooow, don’t you two look classy?
translation: 哦哇，你们两个看起来真有派头！

source: Yeaaah, it really ‘suits’ you guys well! Get it? Suit?
translation: 是啊，真的很“合身”！明白吗？西装嘛。

source: Hey there, Yuri and Aiden! You both look amazing too!
translation: 嘿，Yuri和Aiden！你们看起来也很棒！

source: Yes, you look beautiful, dear… You were still little the last time I saw you in a dress.
translation: 是的，你看起来很漂亮，亲爱的……上次我看你穿裙子时，你还很小。

source: Thanks, Dad! I do feel expensive and elegant, which is very unusual!
translation: 谢谢，爸爸！我确实觉得自己既昂贵又优雅，这可不常见！

source: You’re looking dapper in that suit too, Aiden. I didn’t think formal would fit you so well.
translation: 你穿那套西装也很帅，Aiden。我没想到正装这么适合你。

source: Eh? Really?
translation: 嗯？真的吗？

source: This might be the first time I’ve seen you this covered up, though.
translation: 不过，这可能是我见过你穿得最严实的一次。

source: I know, right Yoshi?! This suit and tie are so tight I feel like I can’t breathe!
translation: 我知道，对吧，Yoshi？！这套西装和领带太紧了，我感觉自己都不能呼吸！

source: Don’t you like the attire, Aiden?
translation: Aiden，你不喜欢这身装扮吗？

source: Haha, come on, you guys know me – I’d rather be in loose clothes or nothing at all!
translation: 哈哈，拜托，你们知道我的——我宁愿穿宽松的衣服，或者干脆什么都不穿！

source: This is way out of my usual comfort zone, but hey! If you guys think I look cool, then I’m fine with it! Plus, it’s not like I have to wear this forever.
translation: 这完全超出了我平时的舒适区，不过嘿！只要你们觉得我看起来很酷，那我就没问题！而且我又不用永远穿着它。

source: Ugh… Don’t get me started on how much these high heels hurt my feet!
translation: 呜……别让我说这双高跟鞋把我的脚疼成什么样！

source: Hahaha! I can imagine!
translation: 哈哈哈！我能想象！

source: W-Well, not really… It’s actually the opposite…
translation: 嗯、嗯……其实不是……正好相反……

source: Hehe… you did… but… It’s a funny story really, you guys don’t have to—
translation: 嘿嘿……你确实……不过……这是个有趣的故事，你们不用——

source: Now everything is too long and baggy for him.
translation: 现在对他来说，一切都太长太宽松了。

source: Yeah, luckily Darius’ attire came with these suspenders he didn’t need since he’s wearing a closed suit.
translation: 是啊，幸运的是Darius的服装配了这条背带，他穿封闭式西装正好用不上。

source: But still…
translation: 不过还是……

source: Wait… that’s not the dress we gave you.
translation: 等等……那不是我们给你的裙子。

source: Why of course I brought my own attire!
translation: 那当然，我带了自己的服装！

source: Would you like me to call for the staff to take your feathers and purse? Just so you’d be more comfortable before our meal.
translation: 要不要我叫工作人员把你的羽毛和手包拿走？这样用餐前你会更舒服。

source: The gown? Cucci! The feather? Verse-ace! The shoes? Louis Butt-on! The jewelry? Stiffany & Ho!
translation: 礼服？Cucci！羽毛？Verse-ace！鞋子？Louis Butt-on！首饰？Stiffany & Ho！

source: Please make yourselves comfortable while I get everyone a menu.
translation: 请让自己舒服些，我去给大家拿菜单。

source: OMG, OMG, OMG, it’s finally happening~!!
translation: 天哪天哪天哪，终于要开始了~！！

source: I wonder what kind of food we’ll have here? Probably nothing I could ever make back at camp!
translation: 不知道这里会有什么食物？肯定不是我在营地能做出来的！

source: Maybe it’ll be something like you see on Food TV Shows!
translation: 也许会是 Food TV 节目里那种东西！

source: Like Masterbaste Chef?
translation: 比如《腌大师》？

source: Either way I think it’s gonna be quite the experience!
translation: 不管怎样，我觉得这一定会是一次很棒的体验！

source: Th-They weren’t kidding when they said we’re going to be treated like royalty here…We have all these staff doing everything for us.
translation: 他、他们说我们会像皇室一样被招待，看来没骗人……这里有这么多工作人员为我们做所有事。

source: Yeah, I’m not used to it either. It’s usually me who does stuff like that.
translation: 是啊，我也不习惯。通常这种事都是我来做。

source: I’m guessing this is going to be a first for most of us, right?
translation: 我猜这对我们大多数人来说都是第一次，对吧？

source: Kindly exclude me from that list. I’m very much used to this kind of setting.
translation: 请把我从名单里排除。我非常习惯这种场合。

source: I’ve taken special lessons on fine dining etiquette from a young age, after all~
translation: 毕竟，我从小就接受过高级餐饮礼仪的专门训练~

source: You’re not the only one who’s tried this before. Right, Dad?
translation: 以前来过这里的可不只有你。对吧，爸爸？

source: Well, not as frequently, dear. And it was usually for business appointments and not leisure dining like this.
translation: 不过没那么频繁，亲爱的。通常是商务约会，不是这种休闲用餐。

source: Although, it’s not unusual to feel intimidated by etiquette rules at first.
translation: 不过，一开始对礼仪规则感到紧张也很正常。

source: Well… most of them are common sense, but yeah, some rules are a little more nuanced, the fancier the place is.
translation: 嗯……大多数都是常识，但没错，地方越高级，有些规则就越讲究。

source: It’s not that hard, just don’t make a mess.
translation: 没那么难，只要别弄得一团糟。

source: Ehh… Easy for you guys to say, I’ve been trying to figure out why there’s a big-ass napkin on my plate. Should I tuck it into my shirt or something?
translation: 呃……你们当然好说，我一直在琢磨盘子上为什么有一张这么大的餐巾。我应该把它塞进衬衫里之类的吗？

source: No, Aiden. Just gently unfold it without shaking it out and place it on your lap.
translation: 不，Aiden。轻轻展开，不要抖开，然后放在膝盖上。

source: Oooh~ I felt fancy doing that~!
translation: 哦哦~这样做感觉自己好高级~！

source: You should know there’s a secret language of the napkin that comes in handy when you need to excuse yourself from the table~
translation: 你应该知道，餐巾还有一套秘密语言，需要暂时离开餐桌时会派上用场~

source: Leaving it on your chair will signal to the waiter that you’re not done with your meal, while leaving it neatly on the left-hand side of your plate will inform the waiter to clear your plate!
translation: 把餐巾放在椅子上，服务员就会知道你还没用完餐；而把它整齐地放在盘子左侧，则表示可以收走你的盘子！

source: The what goes to the what now…?
translation: 什么放到什么上……？

source: It’s fine, Aiden. I’ll teach you later.
translation: 没关系，Aiden。我之后教你。

source: U-Umm… What about these extra spoons and forks? Will I get kicked out if I use the wrong one?
translation: 嗯、嗯……那这些多出来的勺子和叉子呢？如果用错了，我会被赶出去吗？

source: Since it sounds like everyone’s not that willing to learn, you can all just watch what I’m doing and follow~
translation: 既然看来大家都不太愿意学，那你们就看着我怎么做，跟着做就好~

source: Actually, there’s a simple trick to know which ones to use.
translation: 其实，有个简单的方法能知道该用哪一套。

source: Always start with the utensil farthest away from your plate, working your way towards the dinner plate as the courses progress.
translation: 总是先从离盘子最远的餐具开始，随着一道道菜上来，再逐渐用到靠近主餐盘的餐具。

source: Ah, I see. I didn’t know it was that easy…
translation: 啊，我明白了。我不知道原来这么简单……

source: Thanks for explaining, sir!
translation: 谢谢你解释，先生！

source: Those are just the mere basics, though~ There are a lot more to consider especially once the meal has been served!
translation: 不过那还只是最基本的东西~尤其是上菜之后，还有很多要注意的！

source: For example, did you know you’re not supposed to blow on your food to cool it off?  You’re supposed to wait at least a minute to let it cool down!
translation: 例如，你知道不能对着食物吹气让它降温吗？你应该至少等一分钟，让它自己冷却！

source: Pacing your eating is just as essential too! Smaller bites are encouraged even if it takes longer!
translation: 控制进食速度也同样重要！即使需要更久，也建议小口进食！

source: And it’s very important to taste everything on your plate, even if you’re unsure you’ll like it!
translation: 而且非常重要的一点是，要品尝盘子里的每一样东西，即使你不确定自己是否喜欢！

source: Oh, and don’t forget noisy chewing and lip-smacking. That’s just disgustingly barbaric.
translation: 哦，还有，别发出咀嚼和吧唧嘴的声音。那简直粗鲁得令人作呕。

source: Um. No one asked.
translation: 呃。没人问。

source: Y-Yuri…
translation: Yuri……

source: Hngh… I feel like it’s starting to get complicated, though.
translation: 嗯……我觉得事情开始变复杂了。

source: It’s really not, Aiden. You just need to slow down and make less noise than usual. All of us can do that.
translation: 一点也不，Aiden。你只需要放慢速度，比平时少发出些声音。我们都能做到。

source: And if there’s anything some of you aren’t sure of, you can always ask me.
translation: 如果有什么不确定的地方，随时可以问我。

source: Otherwise, just follow my lead and everything will go smoothly.
translation: 否则就照我做的来，一切都会顺利。

source: But that’s what I was sayi—
translation: 但我正是说——

source: Sorry for the wait, here are your menus!
translation: 抱歉让你们久等了，这是你们的菜单！

source: *whispers* As if anyone wants to hear you talk more…
translation: *低声说* 好像没人想再听你说话……

source: Hmm… If you all want, I can help suggest dishes for each of you that might be to your liking.
translation: 嗯……如果你们愿意，我可以帮你们每个人推荐一些可能合口味的菜。

source: I do pay attention to what you often eat during mealtimes, after all.
translation: 毕竟，我一直留意你们平时吃饭时经常吃什么。

source: Ooh, I don’t mind that! I can barely read any of these anyways, hahaha!
translation: 哦，我不介意！这些名字我几乎都看不懂，哈哈哈！

source: For you, Aiden, I’ll get you some porkchops and gravy. With mashed potatoes of course.
translation: Aiden，我给你点猪排和肉汁。当然还要配土豆泥。

source: Wow, Gramps!  I’m impressed! You do know what I like!
translation: 哇，Gramps！我印象深刻！你确实知道我喜欢什么！

source: Noted, sir!
translation: 记下了，先生！

source: Well, Lloyd… That’s duck liver.
translation: 嗯，Lloyd……那是鸭肝。

source: Well, you can have some fish if you want something lighter. Here, how about I narrow it down for you.
translation: 如果你想吃清淡点的，可以吃鱼。来，我帮你缩小选择范围。

source: Ooh, the seafood options all sounds so faaancy! I guess I’ll just order the longest-spelled one!
translation: 哦，海鲜选项听起来都好高级！那我就点名字最长的那个！

source: For you, Darius. Perhaps korma?
translation: Darius，我推荐你点咖喱。

source: Yes. Curry is life.
translation: 对。咖喱就是生命。

source: Ooh! Dad, should I get coq au vin? That sounds juicy~
translation: 哦！爸爸，我要不要点红酒炖鸡？听起来汁水很多~

source: Sure, Yuri. That should be good enough. I think you and Hyunjin will like it in fact.
translation: 当然可以，Yuri。那个应该不错。我想你和Hyunjin会喜欢。

source: For me, I’ll pick the T-bone steak, medium rare with a nice tall glass of red wine.
translation: 对我来说，我要点一份五分熟的 T 骨牛排，再配一大杯红酒。

source: Actually, please make that two.
translation: 实际上，请来两份。

source: You should try this, Yoshinori. I’m sure you’ll love it.
translation: 你应该试试这个，Yoshinori。我相信你会喜欢。

source: You read my mind sir, I was just going to order whatever you did, hahaha!
translation: 先生，你真懂我，我正打算点和你一样的，哈哈哈！

source: For the appetizers and dessert, we’ll take the chef’s recommendations.
translation: 开胃菜和甜点就听厨师推荐吧。

source: Pardon my intrusion, but I can’t help but overhear some of your selections… Allow me to offer some valuable advice.
translation: 抱歉打扰，但我忍不住听到了你们选的菜……请允许我提供一些有价值的建议。

source: Yuri, ssh..!
translation: Yuri，嘘……！

source: Thanks, but no thanks. We’re good with our orders.
translation: 谢谢，但不用了。我们点这些就好。

source: Excellent choices, sirs and madams. I will relay these to the chef!
translation: 很好的选择，各位先生女士。我会把这些转告厨师！

source: Goodness gracious, I can’t believe all of you wasted your opportunity to order something more sophisticated.
translation: 天哪，真不敢相信你们都浪费了点更精致菜肴的机会。

source: Instead, you all let just one person decide everything. And he didn’t even choose appetizers and desserts!
translation: 反而让一个人决定了一切。而且他连开胃菜和甜点都没选！

source: Huh? What’s wrong with that? And why do you care?
translation: 什么？这有什么问题？而且你为什么在意？

source: And aren’t we all ordering from the same menu? With that logic, anything we order would be “SoPhIsTicAtEd”.
translation: 我们不都是从同一份菜单上点菜吗？照你这个逻辑，我们点的任何东西都可以叫“精、致、无、比”。

source: Excuse me, there’s no need to be so rude. I’ve just been trying to share my knowledge ever since we sat down.
translation: 抱歉，没必要这么无礼。我只是从我们坐下以来一直在试着分享我的知识。

source: Because quite frankly, you all looked like you could use some guidance.
translation: 因为坦白说，你们看起来像是需要一些指导。

source: No need to get so worked up about our orders, Emilia. It’s part of the experience.
translation: 没必要为我们点的东西这么激动，Emilia。这也是体验的一部分。

source: Yeah, and we can handle ourselves, no problem. Dad’s got us covered.
translation: 是啊，我们能照顾好自己，没问题。爸爸会罩着我们。

source: That’s not the issue here, the problem is that none of my suggestions are even considered, while everyone just agrees to whatever Mr. Nomoru says.
translation: 问题不在这里，问题是你们根本不考虑我的任何建议，却对 Nomoru 先生说的任何话都照单全收。

source: Calm down, Emilia. There’s nothing to get upset about.
translation: 冷静点，Emilia。没什么好生气的。

source: I’m only trying to prove my point. Do I look upset to you?
translation: 我只是想证明我的观点。我看起来像是在生气吗？

source: Oh my god… Can’t we have this dinner without you trying to argue?
translation: 天啊……我们就不能好好吃顿饭，不要总是试图争吵吗？

source: Argue? I was trying to help. You’re all twisting the narrative on me.
translation: 争吵？我是在帮忙。你们都在歪曲我的意思。

source: Oooh~ This looks good! What’s it called?
translation: 哦哦~这个看起来不错！叫什么？

source: I think that’s ratatouille.
translation: 我觉得那是法式杂菜。

source: RAT?! Didn’t know rich-person food is that exotic?!
translation: 老鼠？！没想到有钱人的食物这么异国情调？！

source: No, it’s not, Lloyd. It’s vegetables.
translation: 不，不是，Lloyd。那是蔬菜。

source: Hihi~ The serving’s so cute and tiny!
translation: 嘻嘻~分量好可爱，好小巧！

source: It looks like rainbow pepperoni..
translation: 看起来像彩虹意大利辣香肠……

source: The appetizers were good. I don’t see the problem here.
translation: 开胃菜很好吃。我没看出有什么问题。

source: A-And we weren’t complaining either… We were just commenting on it…
translation: 而、而且我们也没在抱怨……我们只是评论一下……

source: Just let it go, everyone.
translation: 大家算了吧。

source: Well let’s see if it tastes as good as it looks.
translation: 嗯……看看味道是否和外表一样好。

source: Mmm… It’s delicious! Your orders for us were perfect, sir!
translation: 嗯……太美味了！先生，你替我们点的菜太完美了！

source: Mm-mm! This is way better than anything I can make!
translation: 嗯嗯！这比我能做的任何东西都好吃！

source: My goodness, did we not just have a conversation about table manners? Stop talking when your mouth is full.
translation: 天哪，我们刚才不是还谈过餐桌礼仪吗？嘴里有东西时别说话。

source: Wow. What is wrong with you?
translation: 哇。你到底怎么回事？

source: Emilia, can we please just enjoy our dinner?
translation: Emilia，我们就不能好好享用晚餐吗？

source: How am I supposed to with all of you talking over each other like you’ve never seen food on a plate before?
translation: 你们像没见过盘子里的食物一样互相抢话，我要怎么享用？

source: Why are you so absorbed in what everyone else is doing?
translation: 你为什么这么在意其他人在做什么？

source: All those classes you had for fine dining etiquette, and you can’t even practice what you preach.
translation: 你上了那么多高级餐饮礼仪课，却连自己教的规矩都做不到。

source: Excuse me, I’m doing exactly as I should. Unlike some of you who can’t even keep their elbows off the table.
translation: 打扰一下，我完全按照该做的做了。不像你们某些人，连胳膊都不肯离开桌面。

source: I’m talking about your attitude and tone. Tell me that’s not being disruptive.
translation: 我说的是你的态度和语气。你敢说这不算扰乱气氛？

source: We’re here to have a good time and that’s what we’re gonna do.
translation: 我们来这里是为了开心，那就会开心。

source: We’re already doing you a favor by trying to deflect each of your attempts to spoil this amazing night for us.
translation: 我们已经在帮你，努力挡开你每一次试图破坏这个美好夜晚的行为。

source: I’m the one spoiling the mood?! Preposterous!
translation: 破坏气氛的人是我？！荒谬！

source: Emilia, keep it down… The other tables are looking at us…
translation: Emilia，小声点……其他桌的人都在看我们……

source: Yeah, don’t be such a pain in the ass.
translation: 是啊，别这么烦人。

source: I’ve only been trying to participate the conversation and you all shut me down at every chance.
translation: 我只是想参与谈话，而你们每次都有机会就让我闭嘴。

source: You had nothing nice to say. What did you expect?
translation: 你没说过一句好听的话。你还指望什么？

source: Am I not allowed to have an opinion? How come when I’m the one talking all of you always assume that I have ill intentions?
translation: 我连发表意见的资格都没有吗？为什么每次轮到我说话，你们就总是假定我心怀恶意？

source: How else are we supposed to take it when everything you say is condescending?!
translation: 那你让我们怎么理解？你说的每句话都带着居高临下的口气？！

source: You know what? There’s no point explaining myself to people who won’t even bother to listen!
translation: 你知道吗？没必要向连听都不愿意听的人解释自己！

source: Then leave.
translation: 那就走。

source: Did you not hear what I said?
translation: 你没听见我说什么吗？

source: Leave!
translation: 走！

source: What gives you the right to kick me out?
translation: 你凭什么赶我走？

source: First of all, we’re not at camp, and second of all, even if we were, you’re in no position to boss me around!
translation: 首先，这里不是营地；其次，就算这里是，你也没资格对我指手画脚！

source: This is exactly your problem. Just because you have some title, you think you can abuse your power and dictate for everyone what they can and can’t do!
translation: 这正是你的问题。你只因为有个头衔，就以为可以滥用权力，替所有人规定什么能做、什么不能做！

source: It’s one thing when it’s work-related, but it’s entirely another when you force everyone into a situation where they’re not even allowed to think for themselves!
translation: 如果是工作相关，那是一回事；但当你强迫所有人陷入一种连独立思考都不被允许的处境时，那完全是另一回事！

source: It’s not like that, Emilia. We’re not just following Sir Goro because he’s our leader.
translation: 不是那样，Emilia。我们不是因为Goro先生是领袖才听他的。

source: We’re looking to him for his opinion because he has the skill and experience.
translation: 我们征求他的意见，是因为他有能力和经验。

source: So, you’re saying that I don’t?
translation: 所以，你是说我没有？

source: Enough, Emilia… We don’t have to talk about this… Not right now.
translation: 够了，Emilia……我们没必要谈这个……至少现在不要。

source: Why has nobody pointed out that we have an outdated leader who built this franchise up, then ran it into the ground?!
translation: 为什么没人指出，我们有一个过时的负责人，他把这个品牌建立起来，然后又把它经营垮了？！

source: It’s no secret that the reason the other branches of Camp Buddy closed down was because of his mismanagement!
translation: 其他 Camp Buddy 分部关闭的原因是他的管理不善，这已经不是什么秘密了！

source: And yet we’re supposed to believe that following the same leadership would make a difference?
translation: 可我们却要相信，继续接受同样的领导会带来改变？

source: It’s pretty telling how incompetent the one in charge really is when the only thing that saved the camp from disgrace... was the scouts.
translation: 当唯一拯救营地免于蒙羞的只有童子军时，负责人究竟有多无能已经很明显了……

source: You have no idea what you’re talking about! You weren’t even here for any of that! So, just shut the hell up!
translation: 你根本不知道自己在说什么！那一切发生时你甚至不在这里！所以给我闭嘴！

source: That’s another thing!  The only reason you have the nerve to constantly insult me is because your father lets you get away with all of it!
translation: 还有一件事！你之所以敢不断侮辱我，唯一原因就是你爸爸纵容你这么做！

source: I can’t believe this blatant bias went on for years!  Your confrontational behavior and all your frivolous whims in and out of the camp just shows how hopelessly unprofessional you are!
translation: 我简直不敢相信这种明目张胆的偏袒持续了这么多年！你在营地内外那种咄咄逼人的行为和所有无聊任性，只说明你有多么不专业！

source: How dare you talk to her like that?!
translation: 你怎么敢那样和她说话？！

source: S-Sir Goro, don’t let her get to you…!
translation: Goro先生，别让她影响你……！

source: Hmph! Speaking of which, Yoshinori… you’re the prime example of someone who has been corrupted for so many years.
translation: 哼！说到这个，Yoshinori……你就是一个被腐化了这么多年的人的典型例子。

source: You continue to let yourself be held down and waste your potential, keeping yourself and the camp from a better future.
translation: 你一直任由自己被束缚，浪费自己的潜力，让自己和营地失去更美好的未来。

source: In fact, you all wouldn’t even need a sponsorship if it wasn’t for how badly you handled last year’s scandal and ruined the camp’s reputation!
translation: 事实上，如果不是你们把去年的丑闻处理得那么糟、毁掉了营地的声誉，你们甚至不需要赞助！

source: You should’ve known better than to be so passive and ingratiating – always crawling back to someone you look up to, all because you lack the spine to make your own choices!
translation: 你早该知道，不能这么被动又阿谀奉承——总是因为缺乏做决定的骨气，爬回你所崇拜的人身边！

source: SHUT YOUR FUCKING MOUTH!
translation: 闭上你他妈的嘴！

source: I don’t give a damn about what you think of me, but I’m not going to let you attack my daughter and Yoshinori like this!
translation: 我才不在乎你怎么看我，但我不会让你这样攻击我的女儿和Yoshinori！

source: Your repulsive attitude is the only problem here!
translation: 这里唯一的问题就是你那令人作呕的态度！

source: It has been nothing but absolute stress and displeasure to deal with you, and quite frankly you’ve long overstayed your welcome!
translation: 和你打交道只有无尽的压力和不快，坦白说你早就待得不受欢迎了！

source: Consider yourself finished. I don’t want you at this dinner, at Camp Buddy, or in my sight ever again.
translation: 你到此为止了。我不想再在这顿晚餐、Camp Buddy，或者任何地方看到你。

source: Why am I not surprised that your solution to everything is to just cut it off?
translation: 我怎么一点都不惊讶，你解决一切问题的方法就是直接切断关系？

source: You’re doing it to me, you did it to your scouts and staff, and you did it with your wife.
translation: 你这样对我，对童子军和工作人员也这样，对你的妻子也是这样。

source: I bet when you eventually don’t get your way with Yoshinori, you’ll cut him off just the same.
translation: 我敢说，等你最终无法如愿和Yoshinori在一起时，也会用同样的方式和他断绝关系。

source: This is why nobody stays in your life. Except maybe for your daughter, because you know what? She doesn’t really have much of a choice.
translation: 这就是为什么没人会留在你身边。也许除了你的女儿，因为你知道吗？她其实没多少选择。

source: Do the right thing for once, and keep everyone else out of your midlife crisis!
translation: 做一次正确的事吧，把其他所有人都排除在你的中年危机之外！

source: Disrespect me all you want, but it’s not going to change how hopelessly rotten you are inside and out!
translation: 你想怎么不尊重我都行，但这不会改变你由内到外烂得无可救药的事实！

source: Take a good look at yourself and ask if there’s a single person in the world who's ever wanted you.
translation: 好好看看自己，问问自己这世上有没有哪怕一个人曾经想要你。

source: Not me. Not anyone at Camp Buddy. Not even your own parents!
translation: 不是我。Camp Buddy 的任何人都不是。甚至连你的亲生父母都不是！

source: *gasp* Take that back!
translation: *倒吸气* 把这话收回去！

source: *throws wine at Goro*
translation: *把酒泼向Goro*

source: GRRRR!!! I’VE HAD IT WITH YOU!
translation: 嘎啊啊！！！我受够你了！

source: GRAAHHH!!!
translation: 啊啊啊！！！

source: Sir Goro, no!!
translation: Goro先生，不要！！

source: H-Hey! C-Calm down…!
translation: 嘿、嘿！冷静……！

source: W-Wahh!!
translation: 哇、哇！！

source: Oh shit… oh shit…
translation: 糟糕……糟糕……

source: Dad! She’s not worth it!!
translation: 爸爸！她不值得你这样！！

source: Go on! I dare you!
translation: 来啊！我谅你也不敢！

source: Emilia, stop it already!
translation: Emilia，够了！

source: Sir Goro, ENOUGH!
translation: Goro先生，够了！

source: Grrr… Grr… *heavy breathing*
translation: 呼……呼……*剧烈喘息*

source: Grrr… Grr… *heavy breathing*{fast}
translation: 呼……呼……*剧烈喘息*{fast}

source: What were you thinking?
translation: 你在想什么？

source: What were you thinking, sir?!
translation: 先生，你到底在想什么？！

source: You're better than this.
translation: 你不该是这样的。

source: Sir… You’re better than this…
translation: 先生……你不该是这样的……

source: Take a deep breath.
translation: 深呼吸。

source: That’s right, sir… Just take a deep breath…
translation: 对，就是这样，先生……深呼吸……

source: {i}(All I could do was look into Sir Goro’s eyes to help him calm down.){/i}
translation: {i}我能做的只有注视Goro先生的眼睛，帮助他冷静下来。{/i}

source: {i}(The silence is deafening… All eyes in the room are on us...){/i}
translation: {i}寂静震耳欲聋……房间里所有人的目光都落在我们身上……{/i}

source: {i}(I don’t know what would’ve happened if we didn’t stop him…){/i}
translation: {i}我不知道如果我们没有阻止他，会发生什么……{/i}

source: {i}(Sir Goro’s starting to calm down now… and he’s looking at each of us, and his eyes are filled with regret.){/i}
translation: {i}Goro先生现在开始冷静下来了……他看着我们每个人，眼中充满了悔意。{/i}

source: I…
Hmph… And so, we see his true colors.
translation: 哼……这样一来，我们就看到了他的真面目。

source: What are you getting out of this, Emilia?!
translation: Emilia，你到底想从这件事里得到什么？

source: What? I’m the one who was verbally assaulted here!
translation: 什么？明明是我在这里遭受了言语攻击！

source: Maybe all of you shouldn’t have been so rude, then none of this would’ve happened!
translation: 也许你们所有人不该那么无礼，否则这一切根本不会发生！

source: Fine! I never wanted to be here anyway!
translation: 好吧！反正我本来也不想来这里！

source: Is everything alright here? I heard a commotion…
translation: 这里没事吧？我听到了骚动……

source: No, yeah, we’re good…! Just a little squabble, is all…!
translation: 没、没事，我们很好……！只是发生了一点小争执……！

source: Oh my god… Everyone’s still looking…
translation: 天啊……大家还在看……

source: I hope Sir Goro’s okay, though…
translation: 不过，希望Goro先生没事……

source: Let’s call it a night and get back to our rooms, everyone.
translation: 我们就到这里吧，大家回房间休息。

source: Sir Goro?? Are you in here?
translation: Goro先生？你在里面吗？

source: Sir Goro?
translation: Goro先生？

source: I-I’ve been looking for you, sir… I couldn’t find you around the hotel…
translation: 我、我一直在找你，先生……我在酒店里到处都找不到你……

source: S-Sir Goro? Are you alright…?
translation: 吾、Goro先生？你还好吗……？

source: I… I’m fine.
translation: 我……我没事。

source: {i}(Even with his answer, I know he’s not…){/i}
translation: {i}即使他这么回答，我也知道他并不好……{/i}

source: {i}(With a bottle in his hand and his head held down in this dark, unlit, room... I can’t begin to imagine the shame Sir Goro’s feeling right now…){/i}
translation: {i}他手里拿着酒瓶，低着头待在这间昏暗、没有灯光的房间里……我根本无法想象Goro先生此刻有多么羞愧……{/i}

source: Go back to everyone, Yoshinori…
translation: 回去和大家待在一起吧，Yoshinori……

source: Go back to everyone, Yoshinori… {fast}
translation: 回去和大家待在一起吧，Yoshinori……{fast}

source: I won’t go without you, sir…
translation: 没有你我不会走，先生……

source: There's no point.
translation: 没有意义。

source: There’s no point, sir… I’m sure everyone’s already left…
translation: 没有意义，先生……我相信大家已经离开了……

source: I’m staying here with you, sir…
translation: 我要留在这里陪你，先生……

source: But… you’re not okay, sir.
translation: 但是……你并不好，先生。

source: You don’t have to be alone, sir… I’m here.
translation: 你不必独自面对，先生……我在这里。

source: You can talk to me… I-I’ll listen...
translation: 你可以和我谈谈……我、我会听的……

source: {i}(Even after all the years I’ve known Sir Goro, this is the first time he’s allowed me to see him like this…){/i}
translation: {i}即使我认识Goro先生这么多年，这还是他第一次允许我看到如此脆弱的样子……{/i}

source: {i}(Holding him, I knew he was trembling with frustration over what happened…){/i}
translation: {i}抱着他时，我知道他正因发生的一切而懊恼得浑身发抖……{/i}

source: I’m so sorry, Yoshinori…
translation: 对不起，Yoshinori……

source: I hate that you all had to see me like that…
translation: 我讨厌让你们所有人看到我那副样子……

source: I’m so ashamed of how I acted in front of everyone else… in front of you…
translation: 我为自己在所有人面前……在你面前那样做，感到非常羞愧……

source: I was trying my best to control my anger… But in the end, I couldn’t…
translation: 我一直努力控制自己的愤怒……但最后还是没能做到……

source: But I understand why you lost your patience, sir… All of us were feeling the same way…
translation: 但我理解你为什么会失去耐心，先生……我们所有人的感受都一样……

source: What Emilia did back there was completely uncalled for… and you were only trying to stand up for all of us, just like you have before…
translation: Emilia刚才的所作所为完全不可理喻……而你只是想像以前一样站出来保护我们所有人……

source: Still… It’s not an excuse to let myself fall into a fit of rage like that…
translation: 不过……这并不能成为我让自己陷入那种暴怒的借口……

source: Knowing who I was up against, I should’ve been the bigger person…
translation: 明知道自己面对的是什么人，我本该表现得更成熟……

source: You all look to me to make the right decisions, but instead I chose to let my anger get the best of me…
translation: 你们都指望我做出正确的决定，但我却选择让愤怒战胜自己……

source: My actions only proved what Emilia said…
translation: 我的行为只证明了Emilia说的话……

source: But none of what she said was true, sir. She was just desperate to defend herself like always, and can never admit when she’s wrong.
translation: 但她说的一切都不是真的，先生。她只是像往常一样拼命为自己辩护，永远不肯承认自己错了。

source: Regardless, my behavior was unacceptable, especially for someone who carries the name of the camp on their shoulders.
translation: 不管怎样，我的行为不可接受，尤其是对一个肩负营地名誉的人来说。

source: We’re here representing both Camp Buddy and Mr. Clermont’s reputation… And this incident might have just cost us our sponsorship…
translation: 我们代表的不只是 Camp Buddy，还有Clermont先生的声誉……而这次事件可能已经让我们失去赞助了……

source: I… didn’t realize that, sir.
translation: 我……没意识到这一点，先生。

source: Everything that we’ve worked so hard for… there’s a possibility that it’ll be lost thanks to what I’ve done…
translation: 我们一直如此努力争取的一切……可能会因为我做的事而失去……

source: I really screwed up big time…!
translation: 我真的把事情搞砸了……！

source: I-I’m sure there’s a way for us to fix this, sir.
translation: 我、我相信我们一定有办法解决的，先生。

source: What happened tonight was something none of us meant for, after all.
translation: 毕竟，今晚发生的事并不是我们任何人希望看到的。

source: I’m sure Mr. Clermont will understand if we explain…
translation: 我相信只要我们解释清楚，Clermont先生会理解的……

source: But that’s just it, Yoshinori… We’ve already been given more than enough chances to make things right for the camp…
translation: 但问题就在这里，Yoshinori……我们已经得到过足够多的机会来弥补营地的过错……

source: What if this was the final straw…?
translation: 如果这就是压垮一切的最后一根稻草呢……？

source: {i}(Seeing Sir Goro look so defeated, I wasn’t sure if there was anything I could do to comfort him. But I have to try.){/i}
translation: {i}看着Goro先生如此沮丧，我不确定自己能做什么来安慰他。但我必须试试。{/i}

source: Sir Goro… I know things aren’t going the way you planned…
translation: Goro先生……我知道事情没有按照你的计划发展……

source: You’ve gone through so much worse in the past and pulled through every single one…
translation: 你过去经历过更加糟糕的事情，却每一次都挺了过来……

source: I know what’s hurting you right now is something else much deeper…
translation: 我知道现在真正伤害你的，是更深层的另一个问题……

source: So please… tell me what it is…
translation: 所以请……告诉我那是什么……

source: What hurts the most is the realization… that I never had a chance at redemption.
translation: 最痛苦的是意识到……我从来没有机会得到救赎。

source: R-Redemption…?
translation: 救、救赎……？

source: I’ve been trying so hard to work on myself since this season began…
translation: 从这个季度开始，我一直非常努力地改变自己……

source: It took me so long to start making up for all the mistakes I’ve made in the past, and I really believed that it wasn’t too late to change.
translation: 我花了很长时间才开始弥补过去犯下的所有错误，我真的相信改变还不算太晚。

source: I had hoped to redeem myself not only with the scouts, but also with all of you, who’ve been with me and the camp through thick and thin…
translation: 我曾希望不仅能在童子军面前挽回自己，也能在你们所有人面前挽回自己——你们曾和我、和营地一起共渡难关……

source: Trying to be more cheerful and softspoken, I really thought I was doing better…
translation: 我努力变得更加开朗、说话更加温和，真的以为自己做得越来越好了……

source: And yet… it only took one moment to undo it all.
translation: 然而……只需要一个瞬间，就能让一切前功尽弃。

source: When I saw the look on everyone’s faces back there… even my own daughter…
translation: 当我看到大家刚才脸上的表情……甚至是我亲生女儿的表情……

source: All I felt was disappointment in myself…
translation: 我感受到的只有对自己的失望……

source: It made me realize that I haven’t changed at all… I’m still that bitter old man with anger issues…
translation: 这让我意识到，我根本没有改变……我仍然是那个苦涩、易怒的老头……

source: It made me realize that I haven’t changed at all… I’m still that bitter old man with anger issues…{fast}
translation: 这让我意识到，我根本没有改变……我仍然是那个苦涩、易怒的老头……{fast}

source: But we've all changed.
translation: 但我们都已经改变了。

source: But all of us have changed, sir, including you!
translation: 但我们所有人都变了，先生，包括你！

source: And everyone else knows that things are different now and won’t let this one incident define you!
translation: 其他人都知道现在已经不同了，也不会让这一次事件定义你！

source: You're not who you used to be.
translation: 你已经不是过去的你了。

source: But you’re not who you used to be, sir.
translation: 但你已经不是过去的你了，先生。

source: You’ve changed for the better, and nobody will let this one incident define you.
translation: 你变得更好了，没人会让这一次事件定义你。

source: I didn't think of you any less.
translation: 我没有因此看轻你。

source: I don’t think of you that way, sir…
translation: 我不是那样看你的，先生……

source: In fact, I’ve never thought any less of you.
translation: 事实上，我从来没有看轻过你。

source: I still look up to you the same.
translation: 我依然像以前一样仰望你。

source: I still look up to you, just like I did back then, sir…
translation: 我仍然像以前一样仰望你，先生……

source: But that’s the thing… All I wanted was to return to the person I once was…
translation: 但问题就在于……我想要的只是回到曾经的自己……

source: But you don’t have to go back to that, sir! I never expected you to stay the same, especially after everything you’ve been through…
translation: 但你不需要回到那样，先生！我从没期待你保持不变，尤其是经历了这一切之后……

source: You built a home for all of us, somewhere we could always return to, no matter what happened.
translation: 你为我们所有人建立了一个家，一个无论发生什么，我们都可以回去的地方。

source: None of the amazing experiences and memories would’ve been possible if it weren’t for you.
translation: 如果不是你，那些美好的经历和回忆都不可能存在。

source: And we wouldn’t have come this far if you hadn’t selflessly given yourself up for all of us…
translation: 如果不是你无私地为我们所有人牺牲自己，我们也不可能走到今天……

source: That’s something that I will forever admire about you…
translation: 这是我永远敬佩你的地方……

source: Your strength and resilience when facing even the toughest situations… Always giving your best unconditionally for the people you care for.
translation: 即使面对最艰难的处境，你也总是展现出坚强和韧性……始终无条件地为你在乎的人竭尽全力。

source: But you don’t have to keep bearing everything alone anymore… Everyone at Camp Buddy is here for you…
translation: 你不必再独自承担一切了……Camp Buddy 的每个人都在这里支持你……

source: …and I’m here for you!
translation: ……我也在这里支持你！

source: We’re partners, aren’t we?
translation: 我们是伙伴，对吧？

source: No matter how hard I fall, you’re always there for me…
translation: 无论我跌得多重，你总是在我身边……

source: I’ve always known how much I don’t deserve you…
translation: 我一直知道自己配不上你……

source: But… I need you to know…
translation: 但是……我想让你知道……

source: That the only reason I keep fighting and looking towards the future…
translation: 我之所以一直坚持、一直望向未来……

source: …is all because of you.
translation: ……全都是因为你。

source: I can’t fight this feeling anymore…
translation: 我再也无法抗拒这种感情了……

source: From the moment I met you, I knew you were special.
translation: 从遇见你的那一刻起，我就知道你很特别。

source: And when I was at my worst, you still saw the best in me.
translation: 即使我处于最糟糕的时候，你仍然看到了我最好的一面。

source: You gave me hope for the future and a chance at true happiness…
translation: 你给了我对未来的希望，也给了我获得真正幸福的机会……

source: I love you, Yoshinori.
translation: 我爱你，Yoshinori。

source: There you are, Sir Goro!
translation: 你在这里啊，Goro先生！

source: Ah… Yoshinori…
translation: 啊……Yoshinori……

source: Everyone else has settled into their tents for the night, but…
translation: 其他人都已经回帐篷休息了，不过……

source: …Yuri told me you came up here to answer a call?
translation: ……Yuri告诉我，你来这里接电话了？

source: I-Is everything alright, sir…?
translation: 先、先生……没事吧……？

source: I hope you don’t mind if I stay here with you…
translation: 希望你不介意我留在这里陪你……

source: Yoshinori…
translation: Yoshinori……

source: It’s over…
translation: 结束了……

source: What is…?
translation: 什么结束了……？

source: My wife… We’re over… for good this time.
translation: 我的婚姻……这次我们彻底结束了。

source: While we were on this trip… I found out that my wife has been… seeing someone else.
translation: 我们旅行期间……我发现我的妻子一直……在和别人交往。

source: Everything made sense about why she’s never around for me and Yuri…
translation: 这就解释了她为什么从来不在我和Yuri身边……

source: I-I’m so sorry, sir…
translation: 我、我很抱歉，先生……

source: To be honest, I think I’ve always known, deep in my heart, and just kept denying it…
translation: 老实说，我想我一直在内心深处知道，只是不停地否认……

source: I was going to forgive her… and try to work things out so we could still be a family… but I shouldn’t force her anymore.
translation: 我本来打算原谅她……努力解决问题，这样我们还能继续成为一家人……但我不该再强迫她了。

source: It’s about time I let go…
translation: 我该放手了……

source: I had it coming… For all the mistakes I’ve made in the past.
translation: 这是我自作自受……为我过去犯下的所有错误。

source: Having a family at a young age, I kept pushing for the idea of a perfect one.
translation: 年轻时就组建家庭，我一直执着于拥有一个完美的家庭。

source: I tried to change my ways, and only wanted to be a good husband and father. I did everything in my power to keep us together.
translation: 我努力改变自己，只想成为一个好丈夫和父亲。我用尽一切力量维持我们的关系。

source: But in the end, it only hurt me… my wife… and my daughter in the process… And none of us were truly happy…
translation: 但最后，这只是在伤害我……我的妻子……还有我的女儿……而且我们没有一个人真正幸福……

source: I ruined my family… I was never going to be good enough… Everything was a mistake.
translation: 我毁了我的家庭……我永远不可能做得足够好……这一切都是错误。

source: Th-That’s not true, sir! What about Yuri?
translation: 这、这不是真的，先生！Yuri呢？

source: And what about Camp Buddy?!
translation: Camp Buddy 呢？！

source: You’ve given me, Yuri, and everyone else here a place to belong that we never had before!
translation: 你给了我、Yuri和这里的所有人一个我们从未拥有过的归属之处！

source: I know we’ve only been together for the summer, but it’s the best one I’ve ever had!
translation: 我知道我们只共度了这个夏天，但这是我度过的最棒的夏天！

source: Here I’ve finally been able to make new friends, unforgettable memories, and most importantly… meet you!
translation: 在这里，我终于交到了新朋友，拥有了难忘的回忆，更重要的是……遇见了你！

source: And for that, I’m forever grateful!
translation: 而且为此，我永远感激你！

source: Not everything is lost, sir…! We’re all a part of your family now, too!
translation: 并不是一切都失去了，先生……！现在我们也都是你家人中的一员了！

source: You’re right… I still have Camp Buddy… Yuri… and you.
translation: 你说得对……我还有 Camp Buddy……Yuri……还有你。

source: This isn’t really the best look for your scoutmaster, especially on our last camping trip together.
translation: 你们的童军团长这副样子可不太体面，尤其这还是我们最后一次一起露营。

source: And I can’t believe I said all that to a scout.
translation: 真不敢相信我把那些话全都告诉了一个童子军。

source: Well, I’m not just your scout, sir! I’m your friend too!
translation: 但我不只是你的童子军，先生！我也是你的朋友！

source: I have to admit… I’ve never had anyone to say all these things to.
translation: 我得承认……我从来没有可以对他说这些话的人。

source: Being a father and a leader, I felt like I had to stay strong and not show any weakness.
translation: 作为父亲和领导者，我觉得自己必须保持坚强，不能表现出任何软弱。

source: I’ve seen how hard you work not only for the camp, but for your family too… All while keeping a smile on your face!
translation: 我亲眼见过你不仅为营地辛苦工作，也为家人辛苦工作……同时还要保持脸上的笑容！

source: That’s why you’re my biggest inspiration, sir!
translation: 所以你才是我最大的榜样，先生！

source: Someday, I’m going to be a scoutmaster like you! A person that everyone can count on!
translation: 总有一天，我要成为像你一样的童军团长！成为大家都能依靠的人！

source: Then maybe you won’t have to do everything on your own, sir!
translation: 那样的话，也许你就不用再独自承担一切了，先生！

source: I know that’s a long time from now, but… when it happens, you can count on me to stay with you here!
translation: 我知道那还要很久，但是……等那一天到来，你可以指望我留在这里陪你！

source: If that’s the case, then I’ll support you while you reach for your dream.
translation: 如果是这样，那我会支持你追逐自己的梦想。

source: I’ll keep this camp alive and make it bigger than you ever imagined it could be.
translation: 我会让这个营地继续存在，并把它发展得比你想象中还要壮大。

source: Until then, I’ll be right here waiting.
translation: 在那之前，我会一直在这里等着。

source: We have to make a promise!
translation: 我们必须约定！

source: One day, I’ll be right back here, and we’ll be together again!
translation: 总有一天，我会回到这里，我们会再次在一起！

source: No matter what happens, we’ll stay strong and keep doing our best until that day comes.
translation: 无论发生什么，我们都会坚强下去，在那一天到来前一直尽我们所能。

source: Partners?
translation: 伙伴？

source: Partners.
translation: 伙伴。
